name: Consensus
description: Consensus is an AI-powered interactive product demo platform that lets presales, sales, marketing, and customer success teams create on-demand video demos and product tours buyers can self-serve through, while tracking stakeholder viewing behavior and engagement analytics.
best_for: Presales, sales, and marketing teams that want to scale personalized product demos to every stakeholder in a buying group and track their engagement, without adding headcount for live demo calls.
features: On-demand, shareable AI-powered video demos that let buyers self-serve explore a product
Interactive Product Tours, including guided or hands-on sandbox-style experiences customizable via prompts
Live Demo Platform supporting real-time demonstrations with data injection
AI Agents that operate autonomously to engage buyers with demo content
Buyer-engagement analytics tracking views, conversion rates, and feature-level interest across a buying group
AI Content Studio for generating and personalizing demo videos, with AI voiceover, translations, and avatars on higher tiers
Integrations with marketing and sales tools including Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, Gong, Salesloft, and Outreach

pricing.starting_price: $600/month, billed annually (Starter plan, up to 5 users)

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.notes: For up to 5 users. Includes Video Demos and Product Tours, AI Content Studio - Lite (AI scripting, voiceover, and translations for dynamic tours), embeddable links, unlimited demos, and marketing analytics/integrations (HubSpot, Eloqua, Pardot, Marketo).

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: For up to 10 users. Adds AI Content Studio - Pro (100 AI video minutes/month, 65+ languages, AI avatars), sales analytics (heatmaps, stakeholder discovery, sales leaderboard), personalized sales links, and sales-tool integrations including Highspot, Seismic, Gong, Salesforce, Salesloft, Outreach, plus API access.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Custom user count and price, billed annually via sales. Adds Simulations, AI one-prompt data/dashboard editing, enterprise analytics, custom reports, SSO, a channel partner portal, and a dedicated CSM.

pros: Publishes real self-serve numeric pricing for its Starter ($600/month, 5 users) and Pro ($1,250/month, 10 users) tiers rather than gating entry pricing behind a sales call

Includes buyer-engagement analytics (views, conversion rates, feature rankings) starting on its entry Starter tier, with deeper sales-specific analytics (heatmaps, stakeholder discovery, a sales leaderboard) added on Pro
Lists direct integrations with widely used sales tools, including Salesforce, Gong, Salesloft, Outreach, Highspot, and Seismic, on its own pricing page
cons: The Enterprise tier, covering simulations, SSO, and a dedicated CSM, has no published price and requires contacting sales
No free trial or free plan is offered, per its pricing page
AI-generated video minutes are capped by plan (100 minutes/month on Pro), so heavier AI-video usage may require the custom Enterprise tier

faq.question: Does Consensus publish its pricing?
faq.answer: Partially. Its pricing page lists Starter at $600/month (up to 5 users) and Pro at $1,250/month (up to 10 users), both billed annually. The Enterprise tier is custom-priced via sales.

faq.question: Does Consensus offer a free trial?
faq.answer: No. Its pricing page shows no free trial or free plan for any tier.

faq.question: What is Demolytics?
faq.answer: Demolytics is Consensus's name for the analytics that track how individual stakeholders engage with its demo content, described on its site as part of its buyer-intent signal tracking.

alternatives.name: Gong
alternatives.description: A revenue intelligence platform that records and analyzes sales calls, emails, and meetings to surface deal risk and inform forecasting.
alternatives.best_for: Teams whose priority is conversation intelligence across live sales calls rather than scaled, on-demand product demo videos.
strengths: Listed as one of Consensus's own sales-tool integrations

alternatives.name: PandaDoc
alternatives.description: A document platform for creating, sending, tracking, and eSigning proposals, quotes, and contracts, with recipient-level engagement analytics.
alternatives.best_for: Teams whose priority is proposal, quote, and contract creation with document-engagement tracking rather than personalized demo videos.
